what: Chainlink stETH/ETH feed, every round, read at the source block. Not used by the market oracle; a historical reference, not a forecast. The feed may update only every 24 h when the price is calm, and it is not a DEX price.

source.method: getRoundData of every round (multicall3, eth_call at the source block); daily sample = last round updated before the end of each UTC day

method: intraday: every round of the feed; the drop in a span is the largest fall from a peak to a later trough, starting from the price in force at the span's start

thirtyDays.note: overlapping 30-day spans starting each UTC day (percentiles only)

drops.definition: drop = largest fall from a peak to a later trough within the span, using every feed round; percentiles by nearest rank

windows.note: non-overlapping 30-day windows from the first daily sample date

dailySample.what: previous method, kept for comparison: last round of each UTC day; drop = from the window's first daily price to its lowest daily price

events.title: What stETH did on Oct 10, 2025

dailySample.note: the daily samples behind the k-of-N counts miss intraday moves

events.note: Chainlink feed reading, not a DEX price. Shows how the stETH/ETH feed moved on a day of very large liquidations; it does not say how any vault behaved.
